blind.why: Rifle at rest (ours Rail vs CS2 M4, t1_022). CS2: glove wraps the handguard with readable knuckles and thumb, forearm tapers in diagonally, and the gun's side profile reads at a glance. Ours: the framing is right, but the support hand is a grey claw of stacked cylinders, the forearm is a fat black octagonal pipe, and the faceted grey receiver merges into one slab.

Pistol at rest (ours Pip vs CS2 t1_023). Both are framed low-right. Ours is a white box with vent slits, held by a dark, unreadable mass of polygons with no visible grip or fingers. CS2's small gloved hand around the pistol is clean and legible.

Rifle firing (ours Arc first shot vs CS2 AK ss_4). CS2's flash is a directional plume sized to the barrel, with smoke. Ours is a radially symmetric 8-point clip-art star with a halo, larger than the handguard, that stops about 25 px from the crosshair.

Sniper at rest (ours Lance vs CS2 AWP t2_019). The AWP is a slim diagonal with a crisp scope and hands. The Lance scope is a drainpipe with crimson bands, the muzzle is a pink coil spring, and the support hand is a splayed grey claw.

biggest_gap: Hands and forearms are still the weakest asset, and they appear in almost every frame. Repro: ?test=1&seed=3&match=1&phase=live, then combat.debug.give(localActor,'rail'|'lance'|'zip'|'pip') (shots/critic-viewmodel/r4/sheet_crop1.png, sheet_crop2.png, sheet_crop3.png). On every long arm the left forearm is an untapered black octagonal cylinder about 130 px thick at 720p. It rises from the bottom edge at x~0.68-0.75 to a cream cuff ring. The support-hand fingers are separate grey cylinders that splay below the handguard instead of wrapping it. The right hand shows as loose grey knuckle cylinders floating in front of the magazine. On pistols the trigger hand is a dark lump with no readable grip, fingers or thumb. The Tap shows no hand at all: the bat floats in from the bottom-right corner (m_tap_rest.png). CS2's support glove wraps the handguard with the thumb over the top, the sleeve tapers and has folds, and the pistol hand reads as a fist around the grip. Fix: model a tapered forearm (wrist much thinner than elbow) entering diagonally from bottom-centre. Make one connected glove mesh whose fingers curl around the handguard or grip, with the thumb on top. Add a visible right hand for Tap and the pistols.
other_gaps: Shotgun and sniper kick snaps the muzzle up 10-18% of screen height in one 1/64 s step, and the flash spawns at the kicked position. Scatter goes from (0.624,0.562) to (0.638,0.461) and Lance from (0.606,0.555) to (0.63,0.37) (kick.mjs telemetry). On the Scatter's first shot the star and halo cover the crosshair: crosshair-box luminance goes 57 -> 128 (n_scatter_fire0.png). Ease the kick in over 2-3 frames, and spawn or cap the flash at the rest muzzle position.

Muzzle flash is a symmetric cartoon starburst far bigger than the weapon on every class. Judge and Scatter stars are about 30% of screen width (n_judge_fire0.png, n_scatter_fire0.png). CS2 uses a short forward-directed plume plus smoke. Make the flash directional along the barrel and roughly halve it.
Tap melee: the swing reads as a flat cream 'spear' wedge across the lower-right 40% of the screen, with no visible bat or hand (m_tap_melee2.png, m_tap_melee3.png). This is unchanged from r3.

Reloads happen under the HUD. The Arc's magazine swap (t=0.4) takes place at x~0.8-0.87, y~0.75-1.0, behind the ammo counter and 'RELOADING' bar. The left hand leaves the frame and the gun just sits with an empty well (crop_reload.png). In CS2 the mag-out / mag-in beat is clearly visible at bottom-centre-right.

Lance bolt cycle: the rifle rolls so the scope fills the upper right and the muzzle swings to (0.545,0.50), right beside the crosshair. The hand working the bolt is never seen (crop_bolt.png). The AWP's bolt-hand beat is the signature moment.

Some taggers are hard to tell apart in the match: Pip and Twin are near-identical white slabs with vent slits, and Zip and Hum share one box-with-rail silhouette. From the in-match angle the Judge reads as a gold flare gun with no visible cylinder.
bugs: Scatter's first-shot muzzle flash covers the crosshair: crosshair-box mean luminance goes 57 -> 128 because the flash spawns at the instantly kicked muzzle (0.638,0.461).
Lance bolt pose puts the muzzle 4.5% of screen width from the crosshair, at (0.545,0.50), during every post-shot bolt cycle.
Tap is held with no visible hand: the bat floats from the screen corner at idle and during the swing.
strengths: Rest framing is now consistent and CS2-like: rifles at muzzle (0.62,0.56), pistols at (0.655,0.635), stable across pitch and crouch.
Rifle and pistol flashes no longer white out the crosshair (Arc spray box 55 -> 123 including the tracer, Judge 58, Pip 64).
Cheap: 4-12 viewmodel draw calls at rest, about 24 while firing, roughly 12k tris. No console errors in four separate match runs.
Arc inspect shows the whole rifle in both hands at mid-frame. The grenade is held with two hands at a sensible size. The scope-in sequence hides the gun before the overlay.
Walk and run bob and the fire climb are present and smooth (run muzzle amplitude about ±0.6% of screen).
